No packet file was changed, and all before/after hashes match.
A node -e summary and a findstr query failed from Windows command quoting; used private script files instead. No game behavior was affected.

verdict: 84.0/100. A visually cohesive, information-rich and demonstrably completable phone trading game. The spatial map and exact trade feedback are the strongest work. Repetitive middle pacing and a small quantity-field clarity defect keep it below exceptional; audio quality and several strategy/combat branches remain unverified. No rubric cap applies.
